name: Druid Wildfire Druid (Bloodstone Press)
body:
Wildfire druids have a unique connection to fire, gaining a measure of fire resistance similar to prairie grasses and learning to move across terrain with the fleetness of flame.

Nature Bond (Ex)

At 1st level, a wildfire druid must select the fire or plains domain as her nature bond.

This alters nature bond.

Wildfire Stride (Ex)

As a wildfire druid grows in power, her gait reflects more and more qualities of wildfire. At 2nd level, a wildfire druid moves with the speed of a wildfire, gaining a +10 bonus to her base land speed. At 3rd level, she gains a +1 dodge bonus to her AC as long as she is wearing non-metal medium or light armor.

This replaces woodland stride and trackless step.

Flames of Rejuvenation (Ex)

At 4th level, whenever a wildfire druid is the target of a spell or spell-like ability that deals fire damage, she automatically gains fast healing 1 for 1 minute even if she doesn’t take damage from the flames. This ability takes effect as soon as the wildfire druid is exposed to the magical fire effect, up to a maximum of 3 times per day. At 15th level, the fast healing equals the wildfire druid’s Wisdom bonus instead.

This replaces resist nature’s lure and timeless body.

Into the Wilds: Wildfire Druid, Copyright 2024, Bloodstone Press; author Beth Jones
